title: Homonuclear diatomic MO configurations
basic_overview: MO theory explains bond order and magnetism. For B₂/C₂/N₂ versus O₂/F₂, the conventional 2p ordering differs.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Bond order first; unpaired electrons second.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Combine compatible AOs. 2. Fill MOs. 3. BO=½(Nb−Na). 4. Count unpaired e⁻.
extra_info_content.factors: Use the standard JAM ordering expected for second-row diatomics.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: N₂ BO=3 diamagnetic; O₂ BO=2 paramagnetic.
